avisosBloqueados.mensaje: Turn them on in your phone settings, under NIVL notifications. Without them the system can't wake you up or remind you of your blocks.

retirarConsentimiento.mensaje: From now on nothing is sent to the AI provider and the coach stops working, including the notifications it prepares. Your data in NIVL isn't deleted. You can accept again whenever you want.

camino.nivelesYPide: {{niveles}} to {{nombre}}. {{nombre}} also requires active days in the arena.
camino.nivelListoPide: Level ready. {{nombre}} also requires active days in the arena.

vista.nombreA11y: Your name. Tap to change it.
vista.avisoRevision: Your name, photo and title are shown to others after review. Until then they'll see a temporary alias.
vista.codigoDetalle: Did someone bring you? Enter their code
vista.panelCreadorDetalle: Your code, your sales and your payouts
vista.statNota: One point for every 100 XP in the area.

ajustes.piedrasDetalle: One is forged for every week of perfect streak. It's spent automatically when you miss a day and absorbs all the damage.
ajustes.pausaVuelve: Back on {{dia}}. Tap to resume sooner.
ajustes.pausarDetalle: Exams, illness, travel. No missions or penalties while it lasts.
ajustes.vibracionesDetalle: When you complete, level up or rank up.
ajustes.avisosActivosDetalle: Wake-up alarm, day blocks and day close. A notification won't ring on silent or in Focus mode: keep your clock alarm set too.
ajustes.avisosSinPermiso: Without permission there's no wake-up alarm or block reminders. Tap to turn them on.
ajustes.abrirAjustesAvisos: Open system settings to turn on notifications
ajustes.oraculoRenueva: The Oracle is included. Renews on {{fecha}}.
ajustes.oraculoPagos: The AI (missions from goals and weekly analysis) uses a real API. It's included with the subscription; without it you can use your own key in the Oracle module.
ajustes.oraculoSinPagos: Payments aren't set up on this server yet. You can use your own key in the Oracle module.
ajustes.envioDatosDetalle: What data goes to the AI provider and to whom.
ajustes.envioDatosA11y: Consent to send data to the AI provider
ajustes.exportarDetalle: A backup with all your progress.
ajustes.cerrarSesionDetalle: Your progress stays saved in your account.
ajustes.eliminarNota: Permanently deletes your profile and all your progress in NIVL.

borrar.activo: The Delete forever button is now active.
borrar.cuerpo: Your profile, missions, campaigns, journal, body and money data, your conversation with the coach, your photos and all your progress are deleted. There's no going back.

suscripcion.android: Deleting your account doesn't cancel a NIVL Pro subscription: cancel it in Play Store > Payments & subscriptions > Subscriptions.
suscripcion.ios: Deleting your account doesn't cancel a NIVL Pro subscription: cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
suscripcion.otra: Deleting your account doesn't cancel a NIVL Pro subscription: cancel it in the store where you bought it.

borrar.creador: You're a creator in the program. If you delete your account, your code is deactivated; the balance already earned is still paid to you: write to support to give us your payment details.
borrar.listo: Done. The button below deletes the account.
borrar.noCuadra: Until the word matches, the button stays disabled.
borrar.campoA11y: Type {{palabra}} to be able to delete the account
borrar.seguroMensaje: Your NIVL account will be deleted. The system can't undo it.

pausa.cuerpo: No missions, no penalties, no lost streak. Pausing isn't giving up: it's strategy.
pausa.reanuda: It resumes on its own on
pausa.reanudaA11y: The system resumes on its own on {{dia}}

codigo.cuerpo: If someone from the creator program recommended NIVL to you, enter their code. It changes nothing for you and can only be set once.
codigo.a11y: Code of the creator who brought you

idioma.autoOtro: Follows the phone. If it's set to a language the coach doesn't speak yet, it writes to you in Spanish.
idioma.titulo: What language does it talk to you in?
idioma.cuerpo: The coach writes to you in this language: the conversation, the notifications it prepares and its reports. The interface language doesn't change.

idiomaApp.nota: The coach and the notifications speak to you in the same language.
idiomaApp.titulo: Which language does NIVL speak to you in?
idiomaApp.cuerpo: The app, the coach and the notifications, in this language. Changing it reloads the app.
